title: Project-scope the end-user attachment download endpoint
reason: GET /api/feedback/{id}/attachments/{aid} stays user_id+source_product-scoped, not project-scoped like the S1-tightened GET /api/feedback self-read (D-P3-6). UUID-gated and non-blocking, but a small isolation asymmetry worth closing for consistency.
trigger: operator promotes, or the next time the /api/* attachment surface is touched
